The UHHformats package provides R Markdown and Quarto templates for HTML, PDF, and Word output. This vignette gives a quick overview --- for detailed instructions and screenshots see the [Getting Started guide](https://github.com/uham-bio/UHHformats/blob/master/docs/getting-started.md) and the [Template Gallery](https://github.com/uham-bio/UHHformats/blob/master/docs/gallery.md) on GitHub.


## Available templates

| Template | Output | R Markdown | Quarto |
|---|---|---|---|
| HTML document | HTML | `html_doc()` | `html_doc` |
| Simple PDF | PDF | `pdf_doc()` | `pdf_doc` |
| PDF report | PDF | `pdf_report()` | `pdf_report` |
| PDF cheat sheet | PDF | `pdf_cheatsheet()` | `pdf_cheatsheet` |
| Word document | Word | `word_doc()` | `word_doc` |


## R Markdown

In RStudio: **File** > **New File** > **R Markdown** > **From Template**, then select a UHHformats template.

From the console:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
UHHformats::create_rmd_doc(dirname = "my_report", template = "pdf_report")
rmarkdown::render("my_report/my_report.Rmd")
```


## Quarto

```{r, eval=FALSE}
UHHformats::create_quarto_doc(dirname = "my_html", template = "html_doc")
quarto::quarto_render("my_html/my_html.qmd")
```

Or install as a standalone extension: `quarto add uham-bio/UHHformats`


## Prerequisites

- **PDF output** requires a LaTeX distribution. Recommended: [tinytex](https://yihui.org/tinytex/).
- **Quarto templates** require the [Quarto CLI](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/).

See `?html_doc`, `?pdf_doc`, `?pdf_report`, `?pdf_cheatsheet`, or `?word_doc` for all YAML options.
